mapper.select: SELECT id, code, parent_code, name_en, name_cn, description, level, created_at FROM taxonomy_node ORDER BY level ASC, code ASC
SELECT taxonomy_code, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM paper_taxonomy GROUP BY taxonomy_code
SELECT p.first_author_country, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM paper_taxonomy pt JOIN paper p ON pt.doc_id = p.doc_id WHERE pt.taxonomy_code = #{code} GROUP BY p.first_author_country ORDER BY cnt DESC

SELECT p.doc_id AS docId, p.title AS title, p.first_author_country AS country, p.publish_year AS publishYear FROM paper_taxonomy pt JOIN paper p ON pt.doc_id = p.doc_id WHERE pt.taxonomy_code = #{code} ORDER BY p.publish_year DESC NULLS LAST, p.doc_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
